'''Mosh Barris''' was a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and then [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] officer.

==Biography==
As a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], Barris served aboard the [[Strikefast/Legends|''Strikefast'']]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he led a ground detachment to an unspecified planet on the edge of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in order to hunt down the smuggler ship ''[[Starwayman]]''. Upon arriving on the surface, the ground forces were unable to find the smugglers, but immediately found themselves in a situation which Barris found dubious. The forces discovered what appeared to be a native settlement of an as-yet-unknown [[Alien/Legends|alien]] people. The terms of the Republic-era [[Unknown Alien Encounters Orders]] required the ''Strikefast'' and its ground personnel to remain until the native people were encountered and documented. During his short stay on the planet, Barris was forced to deal with a native people who caused numerous casualties among his personnel, including the downing and deaths of at least two of the ''Strikefast''{{'s}} [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and their pilots.

[[File:Mist_Encounter.jpg|thumb|left|Barris sees Thrawn for the first time.]]
During the encounter, the ''Strikefast''{{'s}} commanding officer, Captain [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], ordered the deployment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], a group Barris expressed his dislike of to his subordinates. Despite the reinforcement of stormtrooper personnel, Barris made the decision to evacuate the location due to mounting casualties in strange hit-and-fade strikes on the force's compound, taking the entire native site with him. Upon returning to the ''Strikefast'', though, it was revealed to Barris that the hostile "natives" were, in fact, a single alien: [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] warrior exiled to the planet, as he explained, for undertaking a preemptive strike. Barris expressed his protests to Parck's idea of taking the alien back to [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]], a prize he hoped would be similar to the discovery of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] and the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]].

By [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Barris was stationed on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] as the Imperial Prefect. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], disguised as Eamon Yzalli, infiltrated Barris's cabinet and framed him as an Imperial traitor.
